html.finalText:
I added a pricing section and an FAQ section below Features. The lint check found no issues.

- **Pricing:** There's a centered heading and three tier cards. Free is $0, Pro is $19 and Team is $49, each per month. Each card has a three-item feature list and a Button. Pro has a primary border, a shadow, a "Recommended" badge and the primary Button. Free and Team use the secondary Button. The cards stack on mobile and sit in three columns from the md breakpoint up.
- **FAQ:** There's a heading and four question-and-answer pairs. They cover the free plan, changing plans, code export and Team billing.

The prices, feature lists and FAQ answers are placeholder copy I wrote, so replace them with your real details.
